description: Fork of exp064 (val=1.6997 @ 8K). Strip the magnitude leak between out_proj and the unembedder by canonicalizing each LUTBlock output through V2D -> D2V (E=96 dim ranking projection). out_proj real-valued output -> 4560-dim ±1 dominance -> Borda+LN back to E=96. Replaces self.out_ln with a DominanceToVector(normalise=True) which has its own LayerNorm. Param-neutral (192 LN params relocate). Now the entire chain to the unembedder is ranking-only.
